discussion.body: FEAT-004 Import + object management -- impl status: mostly built. Images, SVG, DXF import. DWG shows a stub (save as DXF). Assets drawer. Import inspector: role, replace, detach, relink, flip, rotate 90, fit, usage, versions, crop x/y/w/h fields. Missing vs spec: no in-canvas crop drag. Y-up flip is only at the screen transform. How to verify: drop SVG or DXF, place, export, confirm it did not flip twice.
